copy.headline: That dying vegetable in your fridge is 15 minutes from being a condiment.
Most people watch a vegetable die between day 3 and day 5. There's a 15-minute window that resets the clock completely.
The formula: 1 cup vinegar + 1 cup water + 1 tablespoon salt + 1 tablespoon sugar.
The all-stars:
items: Red onion - ready in 20 minutes, the fastest and most versatile.

copy.headline: Quick pickles last 2-4 weeks in the fridge.
copy.body: You just turned a vegetable that had 2 days into a condiment that has 2 weeks. That's a 10x shelf-life extension for 5 minutes of work.

copy.headline: Quick-pickled red onion goes on tacos, salads, sandwiches, grain bowls, burgers, eggs.
copy.body: One jar runs for 2 weeks and upgrades every meal it touches.

copy.headline: The best rescue move in the kitchen takes 5 minutes and turns a dying vegetable into something you'll actually crave.
copy.ctaLine: fond alerts you when produce hits the pickle window - before it's too far gone.
